ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Covenant PowerShell Launcher
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious command lines used in Covenant luanchers

sequences.query: (((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Sta.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Nop.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Window.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Hidden.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Command.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-EncodedCommand.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*sv\\ o\\ \\(New\\-Object\\ IO\\\.MemorySteam\\)\\;sv\\ d\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta\\ file\\\.hta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GruntHTTP.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-EncodedCommand\\ cwB2ACAAbwAgA.*")))
